title: A Fast Approach for Static Timing Analysis Covering All PVT Corners (S. Onaissi, F. Taraporevala, J. Liu, F. N. Najm)
locator: pp. 777-782 (PDF pp. 1-6). Abstract and §1 (p. 777): experience-based corner choice; rejection of linear PVT models. §2.2 (p. 778): corner dominance and dominance margin. §3.1-3.2 (pp. 778-779): circuits, 15 corners, derates, CRPR, flop-to-flop scope, worst-25% endpoint set. §5.1 and Table 8 (p. 780): setup coverage. §5.2 (p. 780) and Table 10 (p. 781): hold coverage. §6.1, eqs. (5)-(11) (pp. 780-781) and Table 9 (p. 780): anchor/partial-corner hold estimator, conservatism conditions, startpoint stability. §6.2.1 and Table 11 (p. 781): method coverage. §6.2.2 (pp. 781-782) and Table 12: SI. §6.2.3 and Table 13 (p. 782): conservatism. §6.2.4 and Table 14 (p. 782): runtimes. §7 (p. 782): intended for non-final runs.
limitations: Read from the Internet Archive raw capture (2024-02-03) of the author-hosted PDF, because the live author URL failed at the TLS handshake. The capture's identity with the published version is supported only by matching title, authors, pages and DOI (Crossref), not by a publisher copy. The timer and circuits are unnamed. Results cover flop-to-flop paths and the worst 25% of endpoints only. Read by the proposer; the verifier must re-open it (docs/EVIDENCE.md line 19). Supersedes the round-0 metadata-only record.
